The activity requires an automated policy compliance flagging system for travel expenses (flights, hotels, vendor preferences) that routes violations for pre-approval. None of the candidates address travel expense policy enforcement:

- Material Receipt, Procurement Data, and Vendor Master APIs handle procurement of goods/materials, not travel expenses
- Procurement Metrics Hub provides analytical KPIs but lacks active flagging/routing capabilities
- Production Change Orchestrator manages manufacturing changes, not travel approvals
- Invoice Management and Supply Chain APIs focus on vendor invoices and material sourcing, not travel policy compliance

The candidates surfaced are topically related to procurement/vendor management but fundamentally misaligned with travel expense policy enforcement and pre-approval routing. A travel expense policy engine or approval workflow system would be needed.
